title: 第一卷 第21章 嘭嘭嘭第一卷 第22章 小棉袄漏风了
content_zh:
阳光透过小破屋漏风的窗户，照出床上那道盘坐的身影。
陈玄膝盖上放着一本书，一手攥着野果，一手压着书页仔细翻阅。
是昨日买来的‘天地周始’。
其上所写，天下分五洲：中昆吾洲、东沧衍洲、西烬芜洲、南漓垠洲、北云朔洲。
五洲之地以外有混沌界域。
混沌界域并非某个独立的天地，而是无数类似五洲之地世界的统称。
生活的多是未知生灵，以及上古一场大战落败后退居混沌中的妖族。
那场大战的细节却是没有记载。
五洲之地有四大道承，分别为：人道、天道、禅道以及魔道。
四大道承是早已飞升的四位圣人所创，信仰教义各不相同，也都有所属的道经留下。
其中，以天人两道最为繁盛，所属宗门遍布五洲各地，飞仙门便是属于人道宗门，却也不是什么大宗门。
几大道承按各宗祖师身份和所修经文，加上宗门整体实力，有明确的等级划分。
第一档是仙宗。
第二档是宗。
第三档是门。
飞仙门就属于这第三档，但由于沧衍洲偏居一隅，宗门本身就不多，也就导致飞仙门风头极盛，建得比许多昆吾洲的二流宗门都要气派。
此外，书上还讲了……
缥缈仙宗祖师和灵檀仙宗老道的不解之秘？
这什么鬼！
又往后翻了几页，陈玄便收起书籍。

这本书前面的内容还算正常，后面却是如话本小说，纯属胡编乱造，比如什么某宗宗主和圣女的师徒情缘……
都是些乱七八糟没有根据的东西。
纯属是为了凑字数，整本看上去很厚的书籍，正经科普不过三四页。
就这还花费了一颗灵晶！
修仙世界坏人多，买卖物品需谨慎！
陈玄心中郁结，却也只能认栽，注入些许法力到吊坠中，取出陶罐放在手心，看了眼里头清一色的蓝色灵晶，以及两本羊皮纸的法术书籍。
昨晚一回来，就把兑换的低阶灵晶，连同两本法术书籍一股脑塞进陶罐里，一夜时间已经完成了‘改造’。
陈玄从里头取出那两本书籍，只见一本上写着‘归元隐气诀’，另一本上写着‘九阳真火诀’。
顿时心头一阵狂喜。
两本皆为地阶法术！
你问陈玄为什么会知道，因为封面上写了个大大的‘地’字！
按照修仙界的惯例，法术典籍一般分天地玄黄四档，天阶最强，黄阶最次。
“不错不错，这趟没白跑。”
陈玄自言自语，掌着两本书左看右看，有些纠结，“先修哪本好呢……”
陶罐进化并未改变原有的属性，归元隐气诀一看就是隐藏修为的法术，而九阳真火诀是火焰类的法术。
这点让陈玄颇为满意。
犹豫再三，决定还是先修习九阳真火诀。
毕竟他现在炼气中期的修为，属实是没什么好隐藏的。
如今确定要从丹道入手，炼丹使用的火焰与成丹品质直接挂钩，自是要先从火焰类法术修起。
念及此处，他不再犹豫，将归元隐气诀收入储物法宝中，翻开九阳真火诀开始研读。

依旧老规矩，先看总纲，再粗略浏览一遍，然后从头开始修习。
最开始的步骤与炼气法本内容大致相同，无外乎就是修行单一火道根那点操作，只是加了些许细节。
引气入体，气运周天。
气沉丹田，炼气聚根。
content_en:
The sun shines through the leaky window of the small shabby house, illuminating the figure sitting cross-legged on the bed.
Chen Xuan had a book on his knees, holding a wild fruit in one hand and pressing the pages with the other to read carefully.
It’s the ‘Heaven and Earth Zhou Beginning’ that I bought yesterday.
It is written on it that the world is divided into five continents: Zhongkunwuzhou, Dongcangyanzhou, Xijinwuzhou, Nanliyinzhou and Beiyunshuozhou.
Beyond the Five Continents there is the Realm of Chaos.
The Chaos Realm is not an independent world, but a collective name for countless worlds similar to the Five Continents.
Most of the people living here are unknown creatures, as well as demon clans that retreated into chaos after losing a great battle in ancient times.
The details of that battle are not recorded.
There are four great inheritances in the land of Five Continents, namely: the Way of Humanity, the Way of Heaven, the Way of Zen, and the Way of Demons.
The Four Great Inheritances were created by four saints who had already ascended. They have different beliefs and doctrines, and they all have their own Taoist scriptures left behind.
Among them, the two realms of heaven and humanity are the most prosperous, with their sects spread all over the five continents. Feixianmen belongs to the human realm sect, but it is not a big sect.
There are clear hierarchical divisions among the several great sects based on the identity of each sect's founder and the scriptures they have cultivated, as well as the overall strength of the sect.
The first level is Xianzong.
The second level is Zong.
The third gear is the door.
Feixianmen belongs to this third category, but because Cangyan Continent is located in a corner, there are not many sects, which makes Feixianmen very popular, and it is built more grandly than many second-rate sects in Kunwu Continent.
In addition, the book also talks about...
The incomprehensible secret of the founder of the Piaomiao Immortal Sect and the veteran of the Lingtan Immortal Sect?
What the hell!
After flipping through a few more pages, Chen Xuan put away the book.
The content in the front of this book is quite normal, but the back is like a novel, which is purely made up, such as the master-disciple relationship between a certain sect leader and a saint...
It's all nonsense and baseless stuff.
It is purely to make up the word count. The entire book, which looks very thick, only contains three or four pages of serious science.
This cost one spiritual crystal!
There are many bad people in the world of cultivating immortals, so be careful when buying and selling items!
Chen Xuan was depressed, but he could only admit defeat, inject some magic power into the pendant, take out the clay pot and put it in the palm of his hand, and looked at the blue spiritual crystal inside, as well as the two parchment spell books.
As soon as I came back last night, I stuffed the exchanged low-level spiritual crystals and two spell books into a clay pot, and completed the 'transformation' overnight.
Chen Xuan took out the two books from inside and saw that one of them said 'Guiyuan Hidden Qi Jue' and the other one said 'Nine Yang True Fire Jue'.
Suddenly, I felt ecstatic.
Both books are earth-level spells!
You asked Chen Xuan why he knew it, because there was a big word "地" written on the cover!
According to the practice in the world of cultivating immortals, magic books are generally divided into four levels: heaven, earth, black and yellow, with the heaven level being the strongest and the yellow level being the lowest.
"Not bad, this trip was not in vain."
Chen Xuan muttered to himself, holding two books and looking at them from left to right, a little confused, "Which one should I study first..."
The evolution of the clay pot has not changed its original attributes. The Guiyuan Hidden Qi Jue is a spell that hides one's cultivation level at first glance, while the Nine Suns True Fire Jue is a flame-type spell.
This made Chen Xuan quite satisfied.
After much hesitation, he decided to practice the Nine Yang True Fire Technique first.
After all, his current cultivation level in the middle stage of Qi refining really has nothing to hide.
Now it is decided to start with alchemy. The flame used in alchemy is directly linked to the quality of the alchemy, so it is natural to start with the practice of fire spells.
Thinking of this, he no longer hesitated, put the Guiyuan Hidden Qi Jue into his storage magic weapon, opened the Nine Yang True Fire Jue and began to study it.
As usual, read the general outline first, then skim it briefly, and then start practicing from the beginning.
The initial steps are roughly the same as the content of the Qi Refining Method, which is nothing more than the operation of practicing a single fire path root, with just a few details added.
Introduce Qi into the body and move it around the sky.
Qi sinks into the Dantian, refining the Qi and gathering the roots.
